body_html:
#EDU307 "Although we were pleased that the students were making connections, we were also happy that they built on one another’s responses, demonstrated listening behaviors, and referred back to one another’s comments"

Yes! I love free reading, I love choice, but I often find little value in SSR.We had twenty minutes every day when I taught 6th grade...Much of the time got spent with upside books and pretending to read.

The accountable talk that you highlighted make independent reading worthwhile.
